capabilities: Creates Anki cards from Markdown card markers
Syncs edits, renames and removals to Anki
Queues mobile changes in an outbox for desktop processing
Renders embeds, Canvas and diagrams as Anki media
Maps Obsidian tags and folder paths to Anki tags and decks
extras: Desktop sync needs Anki running with AnkiConnect; mobile edits are queued in a vault folder and applied on the next desktop sync. No telemetry, account or hosted service. Versions before 1.0.0 used the plugin ID obsidian-anki-bridge and are migrated automatically.
problem: Markdown notes and Anki decks are separate stores, so keeping cards in sync by hand risks duplicate cards, lost review history, and generated IDs written into notes.

relations.evidence: the plugin connects to a running Anki application through AnkiConnect
Anki Bridge creates and updates Anki flashcards directly from an Obsidian vault
Excalidraw drawings and other visual file embeds rendered through their Obsidian plugin

summary: Plugin that creates and updates Anki flashcards from Markdown notes, keeping card IDs and review history out of the notes.
